name: agent-toolkit
description: Plugins for making a repo work well with coding agents: lean CLAUDE.md files, a project constitution with a why for every principle, and a lead agent that delegates and reviews.

plugins.name: claude-md-standards
plugins.description: Write, lint and review CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md files: keep only what the agent wouldn't do untold. Ships a linter.

plugins.name: constitution-writer
plugins.description: Write or review a project constitution: interview the people who built the repo for the why, route each rule to the right file, and wire it into CLAUDE.md.

plugins.name: orchestrate
plugins.description: Lead a feature as the senior engineer: a strong model plans, briefs cheaper subagents, reviews their work adversarially and reports at checkpoints, raising to you only what truly needs you.
